title: UI refinements for branding text, Preview rounding, and Forge token image sizing

requirements.summary: Remove the exact text "Studio Art Engine" from header branding and the browser document title.
acceptanceCriteria: When no project is selected (Dashboard view), the header does not display "Studio Art Engine".
The HTML document <title> no longer contains "Studio Art Engine".
No other visible UI element contains the exact text "Studio Art Engine".

file_operations.description: Remove/replace the dashboard (no project selected) header branding text that currently renders "Studio Art Engine" so it no longer appears anywhere in the header.
Update the static HTML document <title> to remove the substring "Studio Art Engine" while keeping an appropriate remaining title for the app.

requirements.summary: Round corners only on the large central NFT preview render on the Preview page without affecting other NFT images elsewhere.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Preview page, the rendered NFT preview (canvas/image area) has visibly rounded corners.
NFT images/previews in other areas (e.g., Vault grid, Forge tokens grid) do not change corner radius as part of this requirement.

file_operations.description: Apply a targeted border-radius to the main preview canvas element (the large central preview) via a specific className/style so only this preview gets rounded corners and other canvases/images remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: Shrink the forged token NFT preview image within each Forge token card while preserving layout and behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: In the "FORGED TOKENS" grid on the Forge page, each token image renders smaller than before (e.g., with padding/margins inside the square preview area), matching the intent of the provided reference.
Token image aspect ratio is preserved and remains centered within its preview area.
No functional behavior changes to forged token actions (e.g., delete).

file_operations.description: Adjust the forged tokens grid card preview area so the token is rendered smaller inside its aspect-square container (e.g., center it with padding and a reduced max width/height) while preserving object-contain behavior and keeping delete/hover interactions intact.
